author: Sal_89
what_it_is: Game completed at 100%, all cars in Arcade and GT Mode garage with all cars in all colors
format: Max Drive / PowerSave save: 'Ps2PowerSave' header (CRC32 2a6cf23d, matches), folder BESCES-51719GAMEDATA, 4 files, LZARI stream 1523563 bytes unpacking to 1528760 bytes (1528584 bytes of file data)

title: GRAN TURISMO 4
Game data
save.times: none: a max file stores no file times

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/ps2-card.py 'gran-turismo-4.26579.max' -o OUT: reads the save with mymcplus 3.0.5 and writes OUT/Mcd001.ps2 (an 8 MiB card with ECC, formatted and filled by mymcplus) for lrps2/pcee2/pcsx2, and OUT/mc0/<folder>/ for Play!

converted.read_back: work/ps2/tools/mcfs.py lists every file with the size and SHA-1 put on the card; one-saves (1saves convert + inspect) reads the card and finds BESCES-51719GAMEDATA
converted.timestamps: what the save does not date is 2000-01-01 00:00:00 (JST, as a card stores it); the card's own root entries too
